mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise and economic activity slows.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the federal funds rate increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in a month indicates a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic growth slows.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the unemployment rate increased by more than 0.5% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth by more than 1% over two quarters signals a weakening demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings are expected to decline.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where real GDP declined by more than 1% over two quarters.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% in a month signals a strong supply-side response, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity accelerates.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where industrial production increased by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 5% over two months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as consumer confidence and economic activity improve.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where housing starts increased by more than 5% over two months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in nonfarm payrolls by more than 100,000 in a month signals a weakening labor market, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors react to the immediate economic slowdown.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where nonfarm payrolls decreased by more than 100,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4% and the CPI is increasing by more than 0.5% per month, the combined effect of high interest rates and inflation signals a tightening monetary environment, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increase > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth is negative for two consecutive quarters and the unemployment rate increases by more than 0.3% in the last month, the combined effect signals a significant economic downturn, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 negative for 2 quarters and UNRATE increase > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where both conditions are met.
